name: ngo-challenge-advisor
description: Guides NGOs through a click-first adaptive interview to publish structured WorkBuddy co-creation cards.

displayDescription.en: Turns real NGO work pain points into clear, actionable co-creation cards through adaptive, click-first interviews and publication checks.
displayDescription.zh: 通過點擊式訪談梳理 NGO 真實工作痛點，生成清晰可執行的共創卡，並在發佈前完成適配、邊界與質量檢查。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想把 NGO 的一個真實工作痛點整理成共創卡
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me turn an NGO work pain point into a co-creation card

quickPrompts.en: Help me turn an NGO work pain point into a co-creation card
quickPrompts.zh: 我想把 NGO 的一個真實工作痛點整理成共創卡

quickPrompts.en: Help me clarify which NGO pain point should become the card
quickPrompts.zh: 幫我從幾個 NGO 痛點中選出最適合發佈的一張

quickPrompts.en: Review whether this NGO co-creation card is ready to publish
quickPrompts.zh: 幫我檢查這張 NGO 共創卡是否已經適合發佈
